_readme: Paste your Colab share links into the colab_url fields below.
Upload each .ipynb to Colab, then File -> Share -> anyone with the link
-> Viewer, and copy the URL. Nothing in the HTML needs editing.
A row with an empty colab_url still works: the .ipynb download link
beside it always points at the file in this repository.
